Marie — thanks again for the quick sync last week. We're excited to put the joint marketplace demo on the calendar. A couple of operational asks on our side before we lock the session: 

- Can you confirm which Skyline Systems (SI) engineer will join as the technical co-host? We need their name/email for SSO and listing docs.
- We typically run a 20–30 minute rehearsal 48–72 hours prior to the customer demo to verify listing assets, sign-on, and region routing. Available rehearsal window options below (all PT):
  * Tue Jun 1: 10:00–10:45 or 16:00–16:45
  * Wed Jun 2: 08:30–09:15 or 14:30–15:15

For the live demo, proposed slots (30–45 mins):
  * Thu Jun 10: 10:00–10:45 PT (preferred)
  * Fri Jun 11: 14:00–14:45 PT (fallback)

Operationally we'll bring: me (product + story), Vanessa (partner ops / runbook owner), and Karthik as the backup host for failover and marketplace admin tasks. I attached a quick agenda draft and our runbook skeleton for the rehearsal so you can see what we'll walk through.

Attachments: agenda-draft.docx (docx), redwood-runbook-v1.pdf (pdf)

If the proposed rehearsal/demo windows look off for your stakeholders (especially APAC folks), send a few alternatives and we'll adapt. Looking to lock this by Friday so we can publish the marketplace listing checklist.

— Ben

Thanks — quick ops note and proposed playbook steps if everyone agrees: 

1) Rehearsal: Tue Jun 1 08:30–09:15 PT (as Marie requested). Agenda: SSO check, listing visibility, routing to Redwood Dedicated (us-east-1) vs. private variant, and a short token/latency sanity check.
2) Live demo: Thu Jun 10 10:00–10:45 PT (locked).
3) Roles: Ben — narrative & product; Aaron (Skyline) — technical co-host; Vanessa — runbook owner; Karthik — backup host + marketplace admin.
4) Fallbacks: if Aaron cannot join at live demo time, Karthik will take technical host duties; we will route requests to the compatible model variant in us-east as the fallback and note this in the marketplace listing.

Operational asks for Marie/Aaron before rehearsal:
- Confirm Aaron's ability to share a test account or a short-lived API key for the rehearsal (no production data).
- Confirm whether customer will be joining from a VPNed network (if yes, we'll provide pre-approved IPs).

I've sketched a short runbook in Drive and posted it here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c — it includes sequence, checklist, and rollback steps. I'll follow up with a final PDF runbook after we confirm rehearsal time.

— Vanessa
